messages:
Maria (CS): quick weekly check for Gamma — noticed hosted API spend vs committed. They have a 500k token/week commit; usage this week jumped to ~675k (+35%). flagging potential overage. anyone seeing backend changes or customer ramps? :eyes:
Ishaan (CSM): saw a ramp Wed->Thu after a feature flip. they rolled out a bulk export. pinged their PM to confirm details.
Devon (Ops): looking now. infra metrics look steady but request size distribution shifted a lot — 90th pct token length went from ~120 to ~420. could be prompt or export defaults.
SRE-OnCall: we also saw a spike in 5xxs during the window 2026-03-18 15:40-16:05 UTC (0.8% -> 2.9%). retries may have inflated token counts.
OpsBot: alert: gamma-prod anomaly triggered: spend_burn +32% vs weekly avg (rule: weekly_spend_variance > 20%). details: https://console.redwood/alerts/ALRT-782 :warning:
Ishaan (CSM): pinged Gamma eng to ask if they changed retry/backoff or streaming behavior. asked for a list of recent toggles and rollout times.
Finance (Julia): FYI their monthly commit is ~$3k equivalent. rough forecast if usage stays high: ~$650 overage this cycle. how do we want to handle credit/charge?
Maria (CS): propose triage plan: 1) confirm how much retries contributed 2) ask customer to revert streaming->non-streaming if they already did 3) consider one-time credit if it's our platform bug. assign tasks below.
Devon (Ops): dug into traces — found many duplicate client POSTs with no jitter/backoff. sample headers: ```
X-Retry-Count: 3
User-Agent: gamma-internal/2.1.0
```
I'll open a ticket with Gamma eng and recommend exponential backoff + jitter.
SRE-OnCall: created incident INC-2026-0318-02 for the 5xx + retry storm. root cause investigation in progress; adding traces and spans to the incident doc.
Ishaan (CSM): update from Gamma PM: they pushed the bulk export and then patched the client to remove aggressive retries. they expect throttling to reduce consumption; ETA 24 hrs to see the drop.
Finance (Julia): thanks — hold on invoicing adjustments for now. if usage doesn't trend down by Friday EOD, I'll prepare an invoice amendment and credit proposal.
Maria (CS): action items recap: Devon -> contact Gamma eng + share traces; Ishaan -> validate revert + ETA; SRE -> monitor incident and close when stable; Finance -> prep draft adjustment if needed. reopen thread if spend > commit by EOD Fri. :thumbsup:
OpsBot: scheduled report queued for Fri 06:00 UTC. current weekly_delta: +34%.
Maria (CS): marking this triage as "monitoring" for now. will include in next weekly health check. :white_check_mark:
